class.name: RenderSceneBuffers
class.brief_description: Abstract scene buffers object, created for each viewport for which 3D rendering is done.
class.description: Abstract scene buffers object, created for each viewport for which 3D rendering is done. It manages any additional buffers used during rendering and will discard buffers when the viewport is resized. See also [RenderSceneBuffersRD]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal rendering server object. Do not instantiate this class from a script.

method.name: configure
method.description: This method is called by the rendering server when the associated viewport's configuration is changed. It will discard the old buffers and recreate the internal buffers used.

method.name: get_temporal_history_reset
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the frame being rendered follows a camera cut ([method Viewport.reset_temporal_history]). A [CompositorEffect] that keeps a history of previous frames (temporal filtering, motion blur) should drop it on such a frame, as the engine's own temporal effects do. The previous camera matrices of the frame's scene data are then the current ones.
